newFeatures: New Recycle Bin page: deleted archives can be restored or permanently deleted
Archive name conflict detection with one-click rename suggestions
improvements: Failed renames and edits now roll back automatically instead of losing the archive
bugFixes: Fixed quick-create failing due to field naming mismatch
Creating or renaming an archive no longer silently overwrites an existing one
Save writes and conversions are now atomic, so failures no longer corrupt the original file
Fixed archive visibility not preserved when restoring from the recycle bin
Fixed missing component imports breaking quick-create step 2
Fixed pages staying unscrollable after leaving multi-select mode
Fixed all archives being marked hidden when the save directory does not exist yet
Fixed multiple memory leaks and uncleaned event listeners
performance: Batch archive creation is much faster with single-pass key resolution
Optimized hot paths in archive loading and validation to cut redundant work and IPC round-trips
